we have discovered potent and selective withanolides as anti-PC agents using a high-throughput screening assay targeting genes of the AR pathway.

a high-throughput screening assay targeting androgen receptor pathway genes was successfully developed and applied to identify 17β-hydoxywithanolides as a promising class of natural products with potential for treatment of CRPC.
we identified a series of 17β-HOwithanolides from Physalis peruviana that inhibit AR signaling and are efficacious in a xenograft model of castration-resistant PC.

a novel class of compounds that are potent inhibitors of androgen receptor signaling and have demonstrated in vivo activity against CRPC.
the development of new anti-PC agents from natural products and the discovery of a new class of withanolides with potent anti-PC activity.
the discovery of a new class of anti-PC compounds with the potential to be used in combination therapy for CRPC.

the 17β-hydrxywithanolides identified herein are promising candidates for the development of novel anti-CRPC therapeutics.
the 17β-hy-droxywithanolides identified in our study are the first natural product-based inhibitors of androgen receptor signaling that have been reported.

the discovery of potent 17β-hydrxywithanolides as inhibitors of androgen-induced gene expression and as potential anti-prostate cancer therapeutics was made possible by the successful application of high throughput screening of a natural products library.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 17β-hydoxywithanolides represent the first natural product class identified as inhibitors of androgen receptor gene expression.
we have successfully identified a new class of natural products with potent anti-PC activity.

the high-throughput screening (HTS) of natural products for inhibitors of the androgen-induced genes (AIGs) in prostate cancer cells has led to the identification of the first natural products with anti-prostate cancer activity.

natural products can serve as a rich source for drug discovery and development.
